notes: Sound effects made with ElevenLabs sound generation. id -> {prompt, dur (seconds, 0.5-30), influence (0-1, how literally to follow the prompt)}. Game plays them with sfxClip(id). Run: node --env-file=.env tools/make-sfx.mjs
style: cartoon, funny, bright, kids video game, clean, no music

chicken.prompt: Cartoon chicken surprised squawk BAWK, flapping

chick.prompt: Tiny baby chick high squeaky peep peep

goose.prompt: Cartoon goose honk, silly and loud

pig.prompt: Cartoon pig squeal and oink oink

sheep.prompt: Cartoon sheep baa, wobbly and silly

dog.prompt: Cartoon dog happy yip yip bark

bunny.prompt: Cute cartoon squeak and boing, small bunny

whee.prompt: Cartoon slide whistle going up, launch

poof.prompt: Soft cartoon landing poof with a little bounce boing

dizzy.prompt: Cartoon dizzy tweeting birds swirl after a bonk
